source: {i}(It’s that time of the year again, huh?){/i}
translation: {i}（又到了一年中的这个时候啊。）{/i}

source: {i}(It’s not really my favorite part of the year, but it has to happen eventually… It’s always so lonely to see the camp so quiet and empty…){/i}
translation: {i}（我其实不太喜欢一年里的这段时间，但它终究还是会到来……看到营地变得这么安静、空荡，总让人觉得很寂寞……）{/i}

source: {i}(There's no campers around like there used to be… And that means no activities either…){/i}
translation: {i}（这里不再像以前那样到处都是营员了……也就没有任何活动了……）{/i}

source: {i}(But… this time is different than the previous years.){/i}
{i}(Now that the camp has become successful and popular, the next term will be busier than ever!){/i}
translation: {i}（如今营地经营得很成功，人气也越来越高，下个营期一定会比以往更加忙碌！）{/i}

source: {i}(I guess that’s something I can look forward to! I’m happy that Camp Buddy is back at its peak!){/i}
translation: {i}（这倒是很值得期待！Camp Buddy 能重回巅峰，我真的很开心！）{/i}

source: Anyway, since you weren’t listening to me, I was asking when you’ll be done cleaning up here?
translation: 总之，既然你刚才没听我说话，我再问一遍：你什么时候能把这里收拾完？

source: I need some firewood for the office since the air is getting a little chilly now.
translation: 天气开始有点冷了，办公室里需要一些柴火。

source: Oh, I just finished here, so I can chop some right away!
translation: 哦，我这里刚忙完，马上就能去劈柴！

source: Let me go find Aiden and we'll get it done for you faster!
translation: 我去找艾登一起帮忙，这样很快就能弄好！

source: I doubt he’ll be able to help anytime soon. I just saw Aiden busy with some other chores, so I didn’t bother asking him.
translation: 他恐怕暂时帮不上忙。我刚看到艾登还在忙别的杂活，所以就没去问他。

source: If you want, I can help you instead! I know how to swing an axe around too, after all~
translation: 你要是愿意，我可以来帮你！毕竟我也会抡斧头嘛～

source: Haha, it’s alright, Yuri. I can manage!
translation: 哈哈，没关系，尤里。我一个人能行！

source: Besides, don’t you have work to do with Sir Goro as well?
translation: 而且，你不是也要和五郎先生一起工作吗？

source: *sigh* Don't remind me… I don't know how Dad can stand to keep working  in his office like that all day long – it drives me crazy!
translation: *叹气* 别提了……真不知道爸爸怎么受得了整天窝在办公室里工作——我都快疯了！

source: Honestly, coming out here to check on you was just an excuse to stretch my legs and get some fresh air!
translation: 说实话，我出来看看你只是想找个借口活动一下腿脚，顺便呼吸点新鲜空气！

source: I guess it can't be helped, Yuri. There's been a ton of legal paperwork for Sir Goro to work on ever since the last term ended.
translation: 这也没办法，尤里。上个营期结束后，五郎先生就有一大堆法律文件要处理。

source: There's so much stuff to do just to keep the place running with only the few of us and almost all the scouts gone.
translation: 现在几乎所有童军都走了，只靠我们这几个人维持营地运转，要做的事情实在太多了。

source: Is that what you were daydreaming about before?
translation: 你刚才发呆就是在想这些吗？

source: I was just thinking about how much Camp Buddy has changed over the years…
translation: 我只是在想，这些年来 Camp Buddy 真的改变了很多……

source: It’s been a roller-coaster ride, huh…?
translation: 一路走来真是跌宕起伏，对吧……？

source: Yeah… I really got the chance to connect with the campers as well… It's probably the greatest term I've ever had.
translation: 是啊……我也真正有机会和营员们建立了深厚的联系……那大概是我经历过最棒的一个营期。

source: It does make me wonder how many of them will come back next year.
translation: 不知道明年他们当中会有多少人回来。

source: Aww, you really do miss them a lot, don't you?
translation: 哎呀，你真的很想念他们，对吧？

source: I’m sure a lot of them will come back! And if not, that’s okay too!
translation: 我相信很多人都会回来的！就算有人不回来，也没关系！

source: Yeah, but I have to be honest… It'll be really sad if I never see some of those campers again.
translation: 是啊，但说实话……如果以后再也见不到其中一些营员，我一定会很难过。

source: Hey, lighten up a bit, will you? I expected you to be less of a worrywart now that everything is going well.
translation: 嘿，放轻松点，好吗？现在一切都很顺利，我还以为你不会再这么爱操心了。

source: The next term is still months away and a lot can happen in their personal lives.
translation: 离下个营期还有好几个月，他们各自的生活中可能会发生很多事。

source: You did your job last summer, and whether they come back or not is up to them.
translation: 去年夏天你已经尽到了自己的职责，至于他们回不回来，要由他们自己决定。

source: But one thing is certain, we all had some of our greatest memories here at Camp Buddy last term…
translation: 但有一件事可以肯定：上个营期，我们都在 Camp Buddy 留下了最美好的回忆……

source: And that’s something that will forever stay in our hearts!
translation: 这些回忆会永远留在我们心里！

source: Haha… Now who’s the sentimental one?
translation: 哈哈……现在到底是谁多愁善感了？

source: Hmph! All I’m saying is, you can cherish the past, but it’s best to focus on what’s ahead!
translation: 哼！我只是想说，你可以珍惜过去，但最好还是把注意力放在未来！

source: Anyways! Those logs aren’t gonna split themselves, Yoshi! I better see a fresh pile of wood chopped by sundown!
translation: 总之！那些木头可不会自己裂开，义则！太阳下山前，我要看到一堆新劈好的柴！

source: I’ll be around the shed if you need me~!
translation: 需要我的话，我就在工具棚附近哦～！

source: H-Hey! I thought you were helping your dad…!
translation: 等、等等！你不是要去帮你爸爸吗……！

source: Oh, he’ll be fine without me for a while! Hihihi~!
translation: 哦，我暂时不在他也没问题！嘻嘻嘻～！

source: Brr… It’s really cold out here… I better get moving.
translation: 好冷……外面真的太冷了……我得赶紧动起来。
咦、咦……？已经有人在这里了吗？

source: I was just chopping some wood over here. You need anything?
translation: 我刚才在这里劈柴。你需要什么吗？

source: Ah, I was about to gather some myself to bring to the office.
translation: 啊，我正准备收集一些送到办公室去。

source: Here, come and get some! I made plenty!
translation: 来，拿一些去吧！我劈了很多！

source: I figured we would be using a lot more now that the weather's getting colder.
translation: 我想天气越来越冷，我们接下来会用掉更多柴火。
